# Product condition 'new' is missing in FO

Hello everyone,

According to the case #30916, fixed by the case #31148, there is a misunderstanding I guess.

'new' has different meanings in other countries, as a product 'just added' or 'now available' vs. new as a condition.

It has been decided to move 'new' from `Shop.Theme.Catalog` to `Admin.Global` to make it appears correctly in BO.

Now if 'new' is selected in BO, how to make it appears in FO ?

In 8.0.3 version, the condition 'new' in FO is showing what appears on the flag, 'new' as a new product 'just added' (=Nouveau).
Therefore, it shows 'Nouveau' as a condition and that's wrong.

The expected condition is 'Neuf', accordingly the selected condition in BO ('Neuf')
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/129511652/232204374-e9aaafac-da39-4af7-b6cc-49ea8f904af6.png)

Thank you in advance to fix this please.
Best regards

## Attendu
Product page, back office :

'New' in Admin.Catalog.Feature
'Used' in Admin.Catalog.Feature
'Refurbished' in Admin.Catalog.Feature

New label in the product listing, front office:
'New' in Shop.Theme.Global

New in the product page, front office (condition):

'New' in Shop.Theme.Catalog
'Used' in Shop.Theme.Catalog
'Refurbished' in Shop.Theme.Catalog

## Étapes
1. Goto BO -> Catalog -> Product -> demo_21 (or any) -> options -> condition
2. Active the condition case to be shown in FO -> select 'new' in french (=Neuf)
3. See the condition of the product in FO (=Nouveau) and not (=Neuf)
